svg.title: AI inference gateway: Kubernetes deployment and demonstration tools

cc:Work.dc:title: AI inference gateway: Kubernetes deployment and demonstration tools
cc:Work.dc:description: The NodePort gateway Service routes traffic from the browser and demo Locust to FastAPI pods. Pods share Qdrant for semantic caching and Redis for request scheduling. Gateway workers use Gemini in real inference mode or a delayed mock in the demo. Prometheus scrapes gateway metrics and Grafana queries Prometheus. Research evaluation runs offline.
